thesis: Decision-critical historical facts are supported by the uploaded FY2025 20-F and TSMC primary-source 2Q26/monthly revenue releases. Revenue, margins, cash flow, capex, node mix, net cash and customer concentration are directly observable. The principal uncertainty lies in the modeled long-run owner-FCF path and geopolitical probabilities, not the underlying historical data.

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue, OCF, capex, R&D, advanced-node mix and customer concentration are filing-backed.
2Q26 revenue, margins, node mix, net cash and H1 cash-flow data are TSMC primary-source figures.
Jan-Aug 2026 revenue growth is sourced from TSMC monthly revenue releases.

counterevidence: The 10-year DCF paths are model assumptions rather than reported guidance.
No reproducible five-year owner-FCF valuation percentile was frozen.
falsifiers: Any later filing that materially revises frozen facts requires a rerun.
